nodes.title: Key Features
nodes.summary: Covers medical expenses including hospitalization, surgeries, outpatient care, prescription drugs, diagnostics and preventive services, plus cashless treatment at network hospitals, pre- and post-hospitalization coverage, family floater plans, and optional add-ons.

nodes.title: Types of Health Insurance
nodes.summary: Types include individual, family floater, senior citizen (60+), critical illness (lump-sum payout), and group health insurance offered by employers.

nodes.title: Benefits
nodes.summary: Benefits include financial protection against expensive treatments, access to quality healthcare, tax deductions (e.g. Section 80D in India), and peace of mind during medical emergencies.

nodes.title: Important Terms
nodes.summary: A table explaining premium, sum insured, pre-existing diseases, waiting period, co-payment, and network hospitals with direct cashless tie-ups.

nodes.title: How to Choose a Health Insurance Plan
nodes.summary: Advises assessing needs, comparing plans on coverage and claim process, checking network hospitals, understanding exclusions, adding add-ons, and reviewing the claim settlement ratio.

nodes.title: Common Exclusions
nodes.summary: Typical exclusions are pre-existing diseases during the waiting period, cosmetic treatments, dental and vision unless specified, self-inflicted injuries, and non-allopathic treatments.

nodes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
nodes.summary: FAQs cover whether health insurance is mandatory, what to do if a claim is denied, and portability of a policy to another insurer.

nodes.title: Useful Resources
nodes.summary: Links to IRDAI (India’s regulator), WHO health financing resources, and India’s National Health Portal.
